notes.subject: jurumu / awoluw
notes.rationale: KJV 'fools mock sin' vs ASV inversion 'a trespass-offering mocketh fools'; Bambara follows the majority reading.

notes.subject: אשם
notes.rationale: 'guilt/sin' vs 'guilt-offering' (ylt); Bambara uses the general word jurumu.

notes.subject: ⟨ko a ye fɛn dɔgɔ ye⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has only the verb לוּץ 'to scoff'; the mock-content phrase is supplied to make the verb readable.

translation: Awoluw bɛ jurumu jɔsi ⟨ko a ye fɛn dɔgɔ ye⟩, nka yɛlɛmaniw cɛ, dumine don.
